cohort: The study included 1146 individual bitches representing 84 different breeds, contributing 1203 inseminations over a 9-year period (2007-2015).
finding: Semen type, semen motility, bitch age, breed, and bitch size significantly influenced whelping rate, litter size, and gestation length, with frozen-thawed semen resulting in lower whelping rates and smaller litters.
mod_finding: Brachycephalic breeds were 11.3 times more likely to have a C-section, and bitches with litter sizes of one or two pups had a significantly higher C-section rate (83%) compared to those with three or more pups (43%).
gest_age: Mean gestation length from LH0 was 65 ± 1.9 days.
